general.description: Core MPD configuration including paths, user, network, and logging.

db_path.description: Path to the MPD database/cache file.

state_file.description: Path to the file storing player state (queue, volume, etc.).

sticker_file.description: Path to the sticker database (used by client metadata like play counts).

log_filter.description: Optional regex filter to limit logged messages (e.g., 'error|warn').

user.description: User account under which MPD runs (must have read access to music).

group.description: Group with access to audio devices (e.g., 'audio').

bind_to_address.description: Network address MPD binds to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

port.description: TCP port for MPD client connections.

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds for clients.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections.

password.description: Optional password for client authentication. Leave empty to disable.

volume_normalization.description: Enable automatic volume normalization per track.

audio_buffer_size.description: Size of MPD's audio buffer (KB). Increase for high-latency outputs.

buffer_before_play.description: Seconds of audio to buffer before playback starts (0 = instant play).

music_directory.description: Root directory containing your music files (must be readable by MPD user).

db_directory.description: Base directory for MPD data files (including db_file, state_file, sticker_file).

sticker_directory.description: Alias for sticker_file parent directory (deprecated, prefer sticker_file).

file_system_refresh_time.description: Seconds between checks for filesystem changes in music/playlist directories.

id3v1_encoding.description: Encoding for ID3v1 tags (fallback to this if tags are not UTF-8).

follow_fifo_order.description: Whether to follow FIFO order in the playback queue (experimental).

audio_output.description: Primary audio output (e.g., ALSA, PulseAudio, PipeWire, JACK).

name.description: Descriptive name for the output (shown in clients).

format.description: Audio format as 'samplerate:bit_depth:channels' (e.g., '44100:16:2' for CD quality). Use 'auto' to let MPD choose.

dmix_channels.description: Number of dmix channels for shared playback (e.g., '2').

auto_resample.description: Allow MPD to resample audio (set to false for bit-perfect playback).

auto_format.description: Automatically match format to source audio.

replay_gain.description: Replay Gain configuration for consistent volume across albums/tracks.

preamp.description: Replay Gain preamp gain in dB (e.g., +6.0 for louder output).

default_gain.description: Default gain in dB if no RG tags present.

limit.description: Maximum peak reduction in dB to avoid clipping (0 = disable).

album_art.description: Album art handling (e.g., embedding or max resolution).

max_width.description: Max width (px) for extracted/embedded album art. 0 = no limit.

max_height.description: Max height (px) for extracted/embedded album art. 0 = no limit.

embed_art.description: Embed album art into the audio stream (for clients without cover support).

decoders.description: Audio decoder plugins (e.g., for FLAC, Vorbis, MP3, DSD).

enabled.description: Enable this decoder (disable if not needed).

priority.description: Priority of this decoder (higher = tried first).

inputs.description: Input plugins for network streams (e.g., HTTP, SFTP).
